cells.rationale: Base rate: October 2026 10-year yields have averaged around 5.20, with 9 of 11 prints above 5.10, but the most recent two prints (5.10 on Oct 15, 5.09 on Oct 16) show a sharp downward trend after the weekly low of 5.037. The series is reported to two decimals, so a print of exactly 5.10 resolves No, and the question hinges on a few basis points. Given the recent momentum lower, the Fed on hold, and the FOMC meeting after the observation date, I lean slightly below 50% but keep meaningful probability for a bounce back above 5.10.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
